mapper.select: SELECT s.subscriptionId, s.userId, s.subscriptionType, s.stripeSubscriptionId, s.status, s.currentPeriodEnd, s.createTime, s.updateTime, u.email as userEmail, u.firstName as userFirstName, u.lastName as userLastName FROM subscriptions s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.userId = u.userId WHERE s.subscriptionId = #{subscriptionId}

SELECT s.subscriptionId, s.userId, s.subscriptionType, s.stripeSubscriptionId, s.status, s.currentPeriodEnd, s.createTime, s.updateTime FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.userId = #{userId} AND s.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY s.createTime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.subscriptionId, s.userId, s.subscriptionType, s.stripeSubscriptionId, s.status, s.currentPeriodEnd, s.createTime, s.updateTime, u.email as userEmail, u.firstName as userFirstName, u.lastName as userLastName FROM subscriptions s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.userId = u.userId WHERE s.stripeSubscriptionId = #{stripeSubscriptionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE subscriptions SET status = #{status}, currentPeriodEnd = #{currentPeriodEnd}, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE subscriptionId = #{subscriptionId}
UPDATE subscriptions SET status = #{status}, currentPeriodEnd = #{currentPeriodEnd}, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE stripeSubscriptionId = #{stripeSubscriptionId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.subscriptionId, s.userId, s.subscriptionType, s.stripeSubscriptionId, s.status, s.currentPeriodEnd, s.createTime, s.updateTime FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY s.createTime DESC

SELECT s.subscriptionId, s.userId, s.subscriptionType, s.stripeSubscriptionId, s.status, s.currentPeriodEnd, s.createTime, s.updateTime FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status = 'CANCELED' AND s.currentPeriodEnd < NOW()
